 Pete Davidson and Elsie Hewitt reunite with daughter Scottie after solo parenting claim
 Chelsea McLaughlin November 2, 2026 - 12.11am 
 shares Share article Pete Davidson and Elsie Hewitt have reunited months after reaching a co-parenting agreement following their split.
 The exes joined forces with matching The Sopranos Halloween costumes, alongside their daughter, Scottie.
 The parents reunited for Halloween with their daughter.  Instagram/@elsie 
 Advertisement The 10-month-old was dressed as main character Tony Soprano in a bathrobe, with a fake cigar and ducks, referencing the show’s famous pilot episode, and a slicked back hairdo.
 Davidson channelled Tony Sirico ‘s character Paulie ‘Walnuts’ Gualtieri in a black leather jacket and with the sides of his hair dyed grey.
 Hewitt wore a maroon tracksuit jacket and neck brace, in reference to Michael Imperioli’s character Christopher Moltisanti.
 She used one of her character’s most memorable quotes with the caption to her Instagram post, writing “smells like Halloween”.
 Hewitt, 30, and Davidson, 32, split in May, after about 14 months of dating and when Scottie was about five months old.
 Read more
 ‘Eat your words’: Block 2026 winners Courtney and Sev’s message to doubters who called them ‘crazy’ after $1.87 million win 
 Soon after, Hewitt publicly suggested she was taking on the bulk of parenting.
 She took to TikTok to hit back at comments that she looked too casual in paparazzi photos.
 Advertisement “That’s not what I’m thinking about right now because I have a baby to take care of, and I also have to work and make money, and I’m doing it on my own, which is hard,” she said.
 When a follower asked if she meant she was supporting Scottie financially without help, Hewitt replied in a since-deleted comment: “I am :)“.
 However, sources close to Davidson quickly disputed her assertions, maintaining that the former Saturday Night Live alumnus had been an active, involved father.
 Hewitt and Davidson have overcome the issues that followed their break-up to reunite with a joint Halloween costume.  Getty 
 Advertisement Advertisement “Pete has made himself extremely available and has provided full financial support,” a source told People at the time. “Pete is actually covering all Scottie’s costs and more.”
 They eventually came to an agreement in late July.
 “We are cooperatively co-parenting our daughter, whose well-being remains our top priority, and we are fully committed to working together to give her love from both of us,” the former couple shared in a joint statement.
 The duo became first-time parents with Scottie’s birth in December.  Instagram/@elsie 
 Advertisement Fans were delighted by the Halloween reunion, proving they had put any differences aside for the sake of their daughter.
 “So happy to see bc you truly have no idea how much this means and will mean to your daughter!” one reacted.
 “Yay for positive co-parenting!” said another.
 Scottie was born in December 2025. 
 Advertisement Advertisement She was named after Davidson’s father, Scott Matthew Davidson, a firefighter who died in the September 11, 2001 terrorist attacks when he was 33.
